    const apiUrl = 'https://pintdownloader.com/wp-admin/admin-ajax.php'

      action: 'process_pinterest_url',
      url: pinUrl,
      nonce: '4d79143d09'
    })

      headers: {
        accept: '*/*',
        origin: 'https://pintdownloader.com',
        referer: 'https://pintdownloader.com/',
        'content-type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8',
        'user-agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/142.0.0.0 Safari/537.36',
        'x-requested-with': 'XMLHttpRequest'
      }
    })

    const body = res.data

    if (!body || !body.success || !body.data) {
      return {
        code: 500,
        message: 'Gagal mengambil data dari Pinterest',
        timestamp: Date.now()
      }
    }

    return {
      code: 200,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      ...body.data
    }

  } catch (e) {
    return {
      code: 500,
      error: e.message,
      timestamp: Date.now()
    }
  }
}
